question:
Refer to the following series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 2 8 2 2 9 9 9 4 6 4 9 7 9 6 5 1 8 6 6 1 6 6 2 7 5 2 7 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 2 8 2 2 9 9 9 4 6 4 9 7 9 6 5 1 8 6 6 1 6 6 2 7 5 2 7 (Right)

Now,

Even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Even — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/655cdd3acd16b1694780684dc212c5d72e1f03a221af3bb11192274fc0b9ee3c.png] Thus, there are 2 even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
